idea: A bike light that clips onto any helmet and charges from the sun so commuters never find it flat

turns.text: Everyday commuters, not sport cyclists. They forget to charge, so they ride dark half the winter. I'm sure there's demand, everyone I know hates charging lights.
Fine, it's a belief for now. The stake is safety, people get hit at dusk. Draft it.
No interviews yet. I've got a bike shop owner who'd talk to me and I could stand outside a station at 5pm.
Let's park research there and move on, I'll do the station thing this week.
